profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Hi! I am currently a Software Engineer at Microsoft. Graduated with a Bachelor's in Computer Science from the University of Georgia. Additional experience in customer service, Full-Stack Development, Web Development, Backend Development, and scripting.

Feel free to connect and reach out to me! I love meeting new people :)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Member of the M365 Security Engineering team dedicated to identifying security detections across Microsoft products and services. Served as a member of the on-call team rotation
• Drove data pipeline project ingesting over 150 TB of security telemetry logs every day, using extensive knowledge of Microsoft Azure resources and deployment functionality

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Member of core UX team tasked with transitioning and developing a new site for support agents including consumer data pages, core UX features, etc. Served as a member of the on-call team rotation
• Contributed to and created several microservices and APIs consisting of sensitive enterprise and consumer client data within strictly regulated data boundaries
• Led project to invent and create a patented config-based UX framework for developing new workflows
• Added page load performance tracking to new site in order to track page response time, render counts, user interactions, etc., helping reduce component render times across the site by 24%
• Assisted in cross-team collaborative effort to produce product activation tooling on a tight deadline
• Led effort to transition Get Help to new UX to add new features, add sister products, enable user sign-in, etc. Developed on-device diagnostics powered through Get Help
• Member of multiple employee resource groups. Trained multiple team members and led team collaboration events unrelated to work

positions.title: Consultant I
positions.description:
• Custom Software Development Business Line
• Implemented custom web service API for a power and utility client’s intranet held in Microsoft TFS
• Led small development team to update and revamp API resources in an Angular and Ionic mobile application
• Maintained 5 mobile applications used to allow easy user access to a Maximo database
• Developed Python script to analyze Primavera P6 logs in order to maximize task performance
• Deployed code using CI/CD pipelines to Azure DevOps including a .NET Sitefinity CMS
• Identified stability concerns in Azure and resolved critical incidents on aggressive deadlines through ITSM
• On Campus Recruiting Task Force member focused on engaging under-represented minority students in tech

projects.title: Full-Stack MEAN Application
projects.description:
• Learned new technologies and developed a full-stack web messaging application using NodeJS and Express to serve as a REST API with Angular as the front-end
• Maintained MongoDB Cloud database to house user data and message posts and deployed finished web application using AWS Elastic Beanstalk
• Implemented password authentication using bcryptjs and user authorization using bearer tokens
